topic_title: Wrong accusative case suffix on the word "Exercism"
excerpt: The Hungarian translation of “Exercism” (accusative form) is rendered as “Exercisst” instead of the correct “Exercism-öt” — this typo appears in at least two places on the same page (the donation banner and the body text).
